msg: Good morning. My 10-year-old daughter and I are staying at Hotel Isla del Encanto for three nights next week and we'd both love to try diving for the first time. Do you pick up from our hotel, and what would it cost? We're from New Zealand.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good morning! The dive mini-course is a lovely way to try diving for the first time. It includes diving equipment, insurance, and a PADI professional; hotel pick-up is included if your hotel has boat access.

Hotel Isla del Encanto isn’t listed among the hotels with confirmed pick-up, so the team would need to confirm the nearest pick-up point and time. I’m sharing the plan details below. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor about the pick-up?

🤿 *Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)*
💰 *134 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

msg: Thank you. Could you please connect me with the advisor about the pick-up? Also, is there a minimum age problem for my daughter, and which of the two options should I choose for her?
reply:
Your daughter meets the minimum age for the dive mini-course: it’s available from age 10, and minors must be accompanied by a responsible adult. The mini-course is an introductory experience, not a certification. The other option at her age is the Open Water course, which is a certification course. You can choose either based on what she’d like to do.

If your hotel has maritime access, pick-up and return by boat are included at no extra charge. The boat may come directly to the hotel, or the team may direct you to the nearest dock or meeting point.

You'll also need:
• Be ready at 9:30 a.m. at your hotel
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 12 hours before flying
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

I'll connect you with an advisor from the Diving Planet team.
They will contact you shortly. Thanks! :)
